newsitem.title: DENMARK: Denmark offers 5.0 bln DKK five pct state bond.
newsitem.headline: Denmark offers 5.0 bln DKK five pct state bond.

text.p: Denmark's central bank said on Tuesday that it would offer a maximum five billion crowns in its new five percent state bond due 2005, including one billion crowns to be offered at the opening price, to be set when the auction opens at 1000 GMT.
An announcment from the bank said that it reserved the right to remove the offer from the match system if the initial amount was not fully subscribed within 30 minutes.
A four percent T-bill issued on January 7 sold out its full three billion crowns in the first few minutes at auction.
Analysts on Friday predicted that the new five percent bond would open with a pre-tax yield around 33 basis points below the benchmark 10-year bond.
At 0815 GMT the benchmark yielded 6.525 percent.
